system.description: You hook a loose thread of the weave and pull. Deal d8 damage to a creature within 60'. If the target is a caster, a magical creature (Fey, Fiend, Duskborn, Construct or Elemental) or under a magical effect, the torn thread comes back to you and the party regains 1 ember.

outcomes.triumph: double damage, and the party regains 2 ember instead.
outcomes.ruin: the thread whips back. You take d4 damage, which cannot be reduced.
